title: Pricing Tickets Bought Together on One Order
content:
Tickets bought together on one Lift Tickets order are priced as a party rather than one at a time.

**The group rate.** Once the order reaches the product's group threshold in tickets, the group reduction is taken off every ticket on that order. Tickets on two separate orders are never added together to reach the threshold, so two orders of five tickets each stand as two orders of five, whatever the threshold of the product they are bought on.

**The guest reductions.** The season passholder guest reduction and the lodging guest reduction are taken where the collective's records show a pass or a stay on the same household account over the ski dates. Where both would apply, only the larger of the two is taken.

**The snowsports school reduction.** The lesson bundle reduction is taken where the same holder also holds a school booking over the ski date.

**The order of working.** Age band pricing is applied to each ticket on its own before any of these reductions, on the age the holder will be on the ski date.

## The order of working, on illustrative figures

Take an adult price of USD 300.00 for the ski date, an age band share of 60 percent and a reduction of 20 percent. All three figures are chosen for this illustration and none of them is a rate of this line.

- The age band is applied to that ticket on its own: 60 percent of USD 300.00 is USD 180.00.
- The reduction is then taken on that amount: 20 percent off USD 180.00 leaves USD 144.00.

## Points of judgement

**On what does the group threshold turn?** On the number of tickets carried by the one order in hand, and on the threshold the product itself sets.

**What do the records have to show for a guest reduction?** A season pass of the collective, or a stay in collective lodging, on the same household account over the ski dates. For the snowsports school reduction, a school booking held by the same holder over the ski date.

**Which age is read?** The age the holder will be on the ski date, not the age at the order.
